answer: A spiral is one fake identity. The lantern is the registry of sealed hosts, one row per device; a serial already in the lantern voids both rows, so every spiral needs hardware no honest key holds. Jade buys seals from vendors who attest one device each and refuse fleets, and the seal price is set by how many seals the market has already sold, so the thousandth spiral costs a thousand jade where an honest key costs one, and splitting across buyers buys no discount. It breaks if a vendor attests fleets, or one owner holds the lantern.
